mapper.sql: qa.id, qa.stu_id, qa.teacher_id, qa.question, qa.answer, qa.status, qa.create_by, qa.update_by, qa.remark, qa.create_time, qa.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , IFNULL(su_stu.real_name, su_stu.username) AS stu_name, su_stu.avatar AS stu_avatar, s.student_no AS stu_no, s.class_name AS class_name, s.grade AS grade, s.major AS major, IFNULL(su_tch.real_name, su_tch.username) AS teacher_name, t.teacher_no AS teacher_no, t.department AS teacher_dept, t.title AS teacher_title, t.specialty AS teacher_spec, su_tch.avatar AS teacher_avatar FROM my_question_answer qa LEFT JOIN my_student s ON s.stu_id = qa.stu_id LEFT JOIN my_sys_user su_stu ON su_stu.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN my_teacher t ON t.teacher_id = qa.teacher_id LEFT JOIN my_sys_user su_tch ON su_tch.user_id = t.user_id WHERE qa.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_question_answer (stu_id, teacher_id, question, answer, status, create_by, update_by, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{stuId}, #{teacherId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
